Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • Persistence: No evidence of cron, systemd units, launch agents, shell profile edits, self-reinstall loops, or background polling loops.
  • Lateral movement: No evidence of Kubernetes service-account token use, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, or GitHub Actions workflow/token manipulation.
  • Obfuscation/loader: The pre-scan base64/encryption-related alerts appear to come from class names or comments. No evidence was found of actual eval/exec/compile, marshal/pickle loaders, downloader stubs, or encrypted payload execution.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • The provided file list and code style appear consistent with an auto-generated Alibaba Cloud SDK model/client package.
  • No evidence was identified for unexpected native binaries, hidden payloads, .dist-info/egg-info manipulation, typosquatting, or sudden suspicious dependency insertion.
  • The pre-scan SOURCES.txt item is metadata useful for review, but is not by itself evidence of a distribution integrity anomaly.
